i.norm: Tests that {@link StringTokenizer} can be configured with custom delimiter and quote matchers via the {@code (String, StringMatcher, StringMatcher)} constructor.

Verifies tokenization when the delimiter and quote characters are supplied as custom matchers rather than the defaults.

The input {@code `a`;`b`;`c`} uses {@code ;} as the field delimiter and {@code `} (back-tick) as the quote character. The tokenizer should strip the surrounding quotes and return the three unquoted values {@code "a"}, {@code "b"} and {@code "c"}.
